fixed.summary: A cook that plans again after an asset changed does its per-file work on the cook's threads: reading the sources, hashing them, parsing each scene for its streaming groups and the assets it names, and checking each cooked file against the manifest. On a project of 1350 assets (161 MB of sources) a cook after one scene changed takes 330-380 ms instead of 670-790 ms on 16 cores; the cooked files and the report are the same bytes.
